## Pitch
A browser space game where a pilot flies, fights, and returns.

## Who it's for
Players with a few minutes in a browser.

## Why
Learn game clients and servers by building one.

## Constraints
Solo builder. Browser only, no install. Server is authoritative.

## Not now
Player markets, mining, travel between systems.
